fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.format: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in upper case
fields.choices: 249 values, such as AD, AE, AF, AG, AI

fields.name: contact
fields.label: Contact by
fields.format: an object of option key to true or false, every key present when read; a key a write leaves out is false
fields.filterHelp: any: at least one of the comma-separated option keys is on; all: every one of them is on; each flag also filters on its own as filter[contact.<key>]=true or false

fields.name: lines
fields.label: Lines
fields.format: a list of 1 to 50 rows, each an object of the fields in `rows` plus the `id` of an existing row to keep; a row with an id updates that row, one without creates it, and a row left out is deleted, all saved with the record; the list order is the rows' order

actions.name: tidy-order-notes
actions.label: Propose AI rewrites of Notes
actions.confirmation: Each selected record's Notes is sent to AI. Nothing is changed: you get a CSV of proposals to review, and import it in update mode to apply them.

fields.name: sku
fields.label: SKU
fields.placeholder: A unique stock code, such as KB-0042

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.format: a rich-text document: ProseMirror/Tiptap JSON, sent as a string

fields.name: specs
fields.label: Specifications
fields.format: a list of 0 to 20 rows, each an object of the fields in `rows` and no others; stored in the order sent

fields.name: imageKey
fields.label: Image
fields.format: a storage key from an upload; images cannot be uploaded through these tools

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.format: a list of the related records' ids; the list replaces the current one

fields.name: channels
fields.label: Sales channels
fields.format: a list of option values, each at most once; stored in the order the options are listed
fields.filterHelp: any: holds at least one of the comma-separated option values; all: holds every one of them

fields.name: keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.format: a list of free-text tags, at most 20 of at most 50 characters each; stored trimmed, without empty ones, each at most once ignoring case (the first spelling kept), in the order sent
fields.filterHelp: any (a bare value): holds at least one of the comma-separated tags; all: holds every one of them; tags match exactly as stored

actions.name: publish-products
actions.label: Publish
actions.confirmation: Publish the selected products? They become visible to customers.

actions.name: reprice-products
actions.label: Reprice
actions.confirmation: Reprice the selected products? Prices are rounded to the cent.

fields.name: percent
fields.label: Change by %
fields.help: Negative lowers prices. Runs in the background; you are notified when it finishes.

fields.name: countries
fields.label: Countries served
fields.format: a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in upper case, each at most once; stored in the order the options are listed
fields.filterHelp: any: holds at least one of the comma-separated option values; all: holds every one of them
fields.choices: 249 values, such as AD, AE, AF, AG, AI

fields.name: products
fields.label: Products

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.format: a rich-text document: ProseMirror/Tiptap JSON, sent as a string

fields.name: platforms
fields.label: Platforms
fields.format: a list of option values, each at most once; stored in the order the options are listed
fields.filterHelp: any: holds at least one of the comma-separated option values; all: holds every one of them

fields.name: flags
fields.label: Flags
fields.format: an object of option key to true or false, every key present when read; a key a write leaves out is false
fields.filterHelp: any: at least one of the comma-separated option keys is on; all: every one of them is on

fields.name: customerRef
fields.label: Customer id (shop)
fields.help: The shop customer on the MySQL connection, by id: a relationship never spans two databases.
